description: Bugsy's plan for every feature in feature-taxonomy.json. This is the one feature list shared by the PRD (docs/prd.md) and the competitor crosswalk. Change a feature's plan here, then rebuild the PRD site.

positioning.table-stakes: Most competitors have it; buyers expect it on day one
positioning.wedge: Few or no competitors fully support it; part of Bugsy's pitch

specs.01: Foundation: tenancy, auth, roles, branches, audit
specs.02: Customers: accounts, properties, contacts, leads, quotes
specs.03: Catalog: service types, price book, product master
specs.08: Billing: Stripe Connect, invoices, autopay, Wisconsin sales tax
specs.09: General ledger: chart of accounts, posting, deferred revenue

features.note: Pipeline stages from lead to signed.
Source is required on every lead; close rate by source in the owner dashboard.
Quotes in Phase 1; good, better, best groups if time allows.
The signature also captures consent to electronic notices and delivers the pre-application offer.
Door-to-door flow: territory map, knock outcomes, quick quote, e-sign and card at the door.
Follow-up sequences for open quotes, renewals and seasonal upsells.
Cancellation reason codes and save offers in the cancellation flow.
An account pays; a property is where work happens; residents are contacts on the property.
Phone systems connect through an API later.
Monthly, every other month, quarterly and custom cadences.
A fixed number of rounds inside a date window, for mosquito and tick seasons.
Square-foot tiers and add-ons; lot size only for yard mosquito and tick.
Needed before the pilot's first renewal season.
12-month term, auto-renew and optional early cancellation fee per agreement; renewal list 30 days ahead.
Termite warranties with yearly renewal; revenue spread over the warranty year.
Re-services are $0 visits on the agreement, with labor and product cost captured.
The whole term is generated as planned visits, each in a due window.
Technician rows by day columns, plus a map pane.
Named gap: GorillaDesk and Pocomos include route optimization at entry prices, so sales needs a prepared answer.
License year, certification category and expiry enforced at dispatch on every plan, not skill matching.
Move a technician's whole day; Wisconsin weather moves whole days.
Installable mobile web app first; a native wrapper is the fallback if iOS limits bite.
Full visit capture with no signal; zero lost visits is a pilot gate metric.
Products picked from the catalog fill in EPA numbers; missing record fields block completion.
Device and station barcodes come with commercial programs.
Cash, check, card on file and a texted pay link; card readers and tap to pay need a native wrapper, so they wait.
Hours export for payroll.
Every ATCP 29.21 field, locked at day end, corrected only by amendment.
Shared master list with EPA number, active ingredients, restricted-use flag, REI, label and SDS.
Certification categories and expiry, license year, trainee clock; alerts at 60 and 30 days.
Inspector export: one PDF plus a CSV bundle for a date range.
Post-application, pre-application offer, resident notice, REI sign and landscape registry notice, each with proof of sending.
Restricted-use products only for licensed, certified applicators, never trainees working alone.
Proposed (decision 12): branch-level receipts and usage in Phase 1; truck stock and transfers in Phase 2.
ATCP 29 records, notices, landscape registry and the bat blackout, as rules data in lib/compliance/rules/wi.ts.
PO numbers and net terms if time allows; consolidated multi-site invoices in Phase 2.
Termite line is small in Wisconsin; graphs, bait checks and warranties in Phase 2.
The bat exclusion blackout check is Phase 1 (spec 05); multi-visit wildlife jobs are Phase 2.
Mosquito and tick seasons through seasonal programs; taxability waits on DOR.
Stripe Connect, one connected account per tenant.
Card and ACH saved on file.
Per visit, flat monthly and annual prepay, chosen per agreement.
Taxability by service type, rate by service address from DOR tables; pest work nontaxable until DOR answers.
Reminders, retries and a past-due flag; late fees if time allows.
One statement per account across agreements.
Settle the contract balance on cancellation; the cancellation fee is its own line.
Double-entry ledger per tenant with a pest chart of accounts.
Summarized journal export for QuickBooks in Phase 1; API sync in Phase 2.
Contract balance per agreement: deferred revenue or unbilled receivable, matching the ledger fixtures.
Visit labor and product cost post in Phase 1; margin reporting in Phase 2.
Payroll is not built; export hours and production pay, post the payroll journal back.
Phase 1 customers get a pay link and emailed service summaries, but no login.
Included in the base price; at least six of nine competitors charge extra for texting.
Not in the PRD yet; spec 11 could include it.
The post-service summary doubles as the ATCP 29.22 notice when the customer consented.
Owner dashboard and standard reports (proposed spec 12).
Retention and cancellations by service line, route and technician. PestPac and FieldRoutes announced churn analytics in October 2026, so this lead may not last.
Stops per day and re-service rate in the dashboard; fuller productivity reports in Phase 2.
Each branch is a licensed business location.
Default roles that tenants copy and adjust.
Moved up from Phase 3: AI receptionists and assistants need an API or webhooks to connect.
Spreadsheet import with dry run in Phase 1; importers for other pest software in Phase 3.
Public website deferred; the intake endpoint should exist at launch.
